{{Infobox|title=Large bricks|invimage=Granite Slab|type=Resource pack feature}}
'''Large bricks''' is the look the resource pack gives to some doubled stone slabs. When two slabs of certain stones are stacked into a full block, Matcha Flavoured shows the block as a wall of large rectangular bricks cut from that stone, instead of the plain stone texture. A double slab otherwise behaves like the full block, so this gives builders brick versions of stones that have no bricks in vanilla ''Minecraft''.

== Behavior ==
The change is purely visual: the double slab is the vanilla <code>type=double</code> state of the slab, drops two slabs when broken and can be crafted back into the full block as usual.
